capabilities: render daily quote, word, history, and prompt cards via code blocks in notes
capture, index, and browse quotes in a sidebar library with search and tag filters
track up to four daily intentions with per-item streaks and completion percentages
keep a one-line daily journal with past-year entries
migrate existing blockquote quotes into structured clio-quote blocks
extras: Runs fully offline if the two online lookups (word definitions, Wikipedia feed) are disabled; only two free unauthenticated API calls are made, cached per day, and no vault content is sent.
intentEvidence: Upgrading from Muse or Almanac (pre-release)? Install this plugin as Clio (clio).
problem: Obsidian daily notes start blank, so users who want a structured morning ritual (quote, word, prompt, intentions) must assemble it by hand.

relations.evidence: Upgrading from Muse or Almanac (pre-release)? Install this plugin as Clio (clio).
Existing muse-quote, almanac-quote, muse-static, and almanac-static blocks still work
Pulls a curated set of significant historical events for today's date from the Wikimedia featured-content feed
Looks up definition and example sentences from the free dictionaryapi.dev API
perfect for Templater dropping the day's value into a daily note

summary: Daily-ritual plugin that renders code-block cards in daily notes: vault quote of the day, word of the day, on-this-day history, reflection prompt, journal, and intentions.
